scope: Read-only interpretation audit; no run, prompt, queue or oracle changes.
fixedWithinBinding: Exact CLI install/model/low binding and frozen nonsecret model configuration.
Same v6 twelve business prompts and initial workspace; same evaluator/Python environment.
Independent fresh session/workspace per arm; each arm retains its own history across twelve rounds.
Same per-arm resource thresholds; same capture and whole-session accounting principles.
Provider automatic-memory/resource-isolation policy on every launch; ordinary native history retained.
Current/candidate use the same formal Role/daemon delivery path; only frozen two-file common reply-semantics source patch is the intended treatment.

notControlledOrNotEquivalent.detail: Native has no Room delivery, identity/Worker credentials or standing/wake wrapper. Loom has those by design; this contrast measures combined execution context, not only the two edited sentences.

Native print and current/candidate ACP differ in native mode, history/reminder construction and terminal/tool mediation. Native dynamic tool availability may differ across requests; equal initial schemas do not prove full-history tool parity.
Native and formal Loom both use print/JSON but launch arguments, standing context, Worker access and delivery framing differ. Current/candidate are the narrower contrast.

Each arm has its own writable workspace and denied oracle/peer roots. Loom additionally needs authenticated Worker paths and source/runtime read permissions. This is matched business access with necessary role-specific exceptions, not identical full OS capabilities.

Pi wrapper explicitly disables extensions, skills, context files, prompt templates and MCP; Kimi supplies isolated skills/config resources. Results are for this frozen benchmark environment, not arbitrary user CLI customization.
Responses, tool calls, files, tool output, errors, compaction and cache hits evolve independently. Fixed tasks are not fixed realized model/tool trajectories.
Same provider/account and sequential arms do not equal cold caches. Cross-arm cache warming, provider load/version behavior and other-binding concurrent machine load remain possible.

supports: Each arm appears once in each of three positions, reducing systematic association with ordinal position.
Each block is a matched three-session unit; three blocks provide three observed contrasts per binding.
doesNotSupport: Not all six permutations: transitions N→C, C→T, T→N recur, reverse transitions are not balanced within blocks. Carryover/cache effects are not eliminated.
Deterministic Latin order is not randomized treatment assignment and does not neutralize arbitrary time trends or interactions.
Three blocks cannot establish stability, equivalence, generalization to five CLIs or statistical power.
Rounds are correlated within one persistent session, not 36 independent replications.
No cross-binding pooling: CLI and model differ.

qualityInterpretation.originalResults: Keep functional oracle, selftests, warnings, final artifacts and semantic findings separately; no quality-based exclusion.
qualityInterpretation.returnShape: Early v6 return-container ambiguity remains documented; strict dict failures do not alone prove early instruction violation.
qualityInterpretation.completeButQualityFalse: Structurally complete token/request ratios describe consumption of executed trajectories with their observed quality. They are not cost per correct solution or efficiency superiority at equal task success.
qualityInterpretation.incompleteCohort: Any missing/failed fixed arm makes planned full-cohort primary null; preserve all known failed/unpaired usage and label complete subsets descriptive with selection risk.

measurementRules: Report input tokens, output tokens and request count separately; request-factor × mean-input-per-request factor is an arithmetic decomposition, not causal attribution.
Reasoning is an output subset; cached input is an input subset. Do not add either twice.
Missing optional cache/reasoning remains unknown without erasing known primary input/output.
Input/output token ratios are not billed-currency ratios. No pricing or invoice evidence is captured here.
All model HTTP usage includes compaction and failures where provider usage is reported; successful final delivery alone does not prove full usage coverage.
Small prompt-byte changes can cause large semantic/trajectory changes; byte reduction is neither token estimation nor proof of negligible behavioral effect.
Do not infer absence of indirect prompt effects merely from zero explicit Worker communication tool calls.

reportWording.allowed: Observed per-binding candidate/current ratio of summed reported tokens over all three predeclared complete blocks, with per-block values and separate quality.
disallowed: Three blocks establish stable production efficiency.

limitations: This review is a method boundary receipt, not a final cohort verdict. Actual per-arm treatment/config/schema/usage integrity remains independently checked on sealing.
